title: The Babai Conjecture on Graph Isomorphism
exact_target: Can isomorphism of arbitrary finite graphs be decided in quasipolynomial time? Babai's cited algorithm attains this historical target.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1156 (ALG-016). CC BY 4.0.
L\'aszl\'o Babai, \emph{Graph Isomorphism in Quasipolynomial Time}, Proceedings of STOC 2016, 684--697, abstract and introduction; arXiv:1512.03547.
